summary: Midnight's maps, treasures and mounts, one quiet evening at a time.
about: A road for the evenings when nothing is urgent: explore every corner of Midnight, find its hidden treasures and glyphs, and collect the mounts they lead to, from the treasure mounts to a renown mount each from Silvermoon and the Amani. Free pace: the next stage opens as soon as you finish one, and nothing here ends with the season.

steps.label: Uncover the whole map of Eversong Woods (Explore Eversong Woods)
Uncover the whole map of Zul'Aman (Explore Zul'Aman)
Uncover the whole map of Harandar (Explore Harandar)
Uncover the whole map of Voidstorm (Explore Voidstorm)
Uncover the whole map of the Coiled Isle (Explore the Coiled Isle)
Find every treasure in Harandar for the Vivacious Chloroceros
Find every treasure on the Coiled Isle for the Auriferous Venomfang
Finish a Prey hunt in each of the four Midnight zones (Midnight Hunter)
Find every skyriding glyph in Eversong, Zul'Aman, Harandar and Voidstorm for the Crimson Dragonhawk (Midnight Glyph Hunter)
Unlock the whole Research Console in Voidstorm, a weekly quest at a time, for the Lab-Grown Stormray
Finish the Eversong Woods set: treasures, rares, runestones, easels and the party (Forever Song)
Finish the Zul'Aman set: treasures, rares, Abundance and the Altar of Blessings (Making an Amani Out of You)
Finish the Harandar set: treasures, rares, moths and the Legends of the Haranir, a few weeks' work (That's Aln, Folks!)
Finish the Voidstorm set: treasures, rares, the Hungering Presence and Stormarion (Yelling into the Voidstorm)
Collect the Brilliant Petalwing, the reward for all four zone sets (Light Up the Night)
Reach renown 17 with the Silvermoon Court
Buy the Crimson Silvermoon Hawkstrider from Caeris Fairdawn in Eversong Woods for 6,000 Voidlight Marl
Reach renown 17 with the Amani Tribe
Buy the Amani Blessed Bear from Magovu in Zul'Aman for 6,000 Voidlight Marl
Finish the campaign and every zone's side stories (Loremaster of Midnight)
Collect 100 different pieces of decor, uncommon or better (Casual Collector)
